_about: Crime families: business, territory, loyalty and the law closing in. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

underground lottery tickets sold in every soi
a casino hidden behind a karaoke bar
loan sharking to farmers before harvest
smuggling rice whisky across the river border
a construction company that wins every contract
fixing horse races and boxing matches
a laundry that cleans more than shirts
territory: a night market that changes hands at dusk
the docks and the warehouses behind them
a chinatown street of gold shops
a border town where three countries meet
the taxi ranks around the central station
a beach resort strip full of tourists
a neighbourhood the family grew up in
a new highway being built through farmland
rival: a younger family with no respect for the old ways
a cousin who wants to be the boss
a police colonel running his own racket
a foreign syndicate with deep pockets
a politician who used to be on the payroll
a widow who took over her husband's crew
a motorbike gang that answers to no one
a reformer who wants the whole thing gone
debt: a son killed in a deal gone wrong
a loan the old boss made and never collected
a wedding insult that was never forgiven
a stolen shipment nobody admits to taking
a life saved in prison years ago
a sister who married into the rival family
a promise made at a funeral
a debt of honour to a monk who hid them once
informant: the driver who hears every conversation

a nephew caught by the police and turned
an old soldier who finally found religion

line: never touch the families of rivals
no drugs in the home neighbourhood
never talk to the police, whatever happens
children are never part of it
never kill a man in front of his mother
the boss's word, once given, is never broken

1: a dead man in the canal at dawn
